crossRefs.note: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.
He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;
translations.bsb: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, atop the burning wood on the altar.
translations.kjv: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
